newsitem.title: USA: Total World sees Q2 loss.
newsitem.headline: Total World sees Q2 loss.

text.p: Total World Telecommunications Inc said Friday it expects a loss for the second quarter comparable to the loss reported for the first quarter.
The company said it would also incur second quarter charges as a result of the closing of an office and the divestiture of two business units.
It said it expected to recognize about $2.0 million in additional costs to close its Boca Raton, Fla., office and relocate its corporate headquarters to Houston.

The company said its board had approved the divestiture of two units -- Financial Standards Group Inc, a credit union auditing operation, and Real Estate Services Network Holding Corp, a real estate group -- whose operations do not pertain to telecommunications.
Total World said it planned to complete the divestitures by May 15.
It said it would write off in the second quarter the $7.0 million worth of assets comprising the units.
The write-off will be "subject to estimated recoveries which are presently being negotiated," it said.
The units generated net losses of about $6.8 million in the year ended September 30, 1996, and losses of $2.0 million in the quarter ended December 31, 1996, it said.
For the first quarter, Total World reported a loss of $0.77 a share.
Total World is a switch-based, long-distance carrier operating in cities like Chicago, Los Angeles and New York.
